articles.title: Hours after Trump reportedly says ‘tired’ Putin is ready for a deal, Ukraine hit with massive strikes - CNN
articles.description: Russia launched a deadly attack on Ukraine overnight into Friday, just hours after President Vladimir Putin met his US and Chinese counterparts for historic trilateral talks in which the three powers billed themselves as a force for peace in the world.
